facts.fact: Makerere University says the VectorCam AI mosquito-identification app was piloted with the National Malaria Control Programme from November 2022 to April 2024 and is to be scaled to 22 districts, 12 with embedded research.

systems.platform: smartphone app; posts data to DHIS2
systems.owner: Makerere University, Johns Hopkins University, Ministry of Health

UGA.note: Only an AI mosquito surveillance app posting to DHIS2 is described; no facility reporting or patient record system.
DHIS2 is named only as the destination of a mosquito surveillance app; the national system's status is not stated.
